propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table lists only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but does not cover the default model us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8 or any global.* prefix variants, leaving them unguarded against temperature parameter rejection.

Temperature parameter and top_p parameter are rejected with ValidationException on opus-4-8 and opus-4-7 models for non-default values (0.0, 0.5 fail; 1.0 succeeds), but the override table does not list these models so the guard does not fire.

The same temperature rejection occurs on both Bedrock and direct Anthropic paths; pydantic-ai silently drops the parameter on the Anthropic path while Bedrock fails with 400, causing nondeterminism in determinism-critical code review Pass-2 verification.

The bare model ids claude-opus-4-8 and claude-opus-4-7 must be added to the override table to cover both provider-prefixed forms (anthropic: and bedrock us./global. variants) with a single entry per family.
